messages:
marta (partnerships): Quick kickoff note — Avalanche Systems (HW partner) wants an early access pilot. Scope: 4 weeks, 2 nodes (A100-equivalent), NDA in place, telemetry + benchmark feedback loop. Need lab seats + SI touchpoint.

sam (eng-lab): Sounds good. Do we have their firmware/image details? Also: are they shipping NVMe to host models or do we point at our model registry?

chris (hw-ops): They ship a vendor image. We need a validation AMI and a network whitelist. I'll coordinate rack/PSU logistics.

alisa (legal): I have the NDA draft from them. Couple of redlines: (1) telemetry scope — must be explicit, (2) publication embargo window. I can send suggested edits by EOD.

marta (partnerships): Thanks. For telemetry we suggested: perf counters + anonymized request traces only (no PII). Sam — we want perf + quality samples returned to them weekly.

sam (eng-lab): OK. Benchmark harness plan: run three profiles — latency tail, steady throughput, and an end-to-end prompt set (1000 prompts). We'll run 3 repeats each. Quick pseudo-config: 

```
benchmark_profile: avalanche-eap-v1
nodes: 2
sequence_lengths: [64, 512, 1024]
clients_per_node: 8
repeats: 3
output: perf+trace (JSON)
```

chris (hw-ops): lab reservation done. hw-lab-bot: Reserved rack 5, seats 2 for Avalanche pilot (slot 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-28).

hw-lab-bot: reservation_id=AVLN-1769876543 slot=2026-04-01:00:00 -> 2026-04-28:23:59

henry (product): Heads-up — marketing asked to hold joint announcement until the end of the pilot and only if latency targets met. Can we get a lightweight weekly pulse so PM/marketing can evaluate?

marta (partnerships): Yes — weekly sync. I propose Wed morning 9:30 PT. Also need an SI contact to validate integration with their stack. Chris, can you book an SI technical contact?

chris (hw-ops): On it. Reaching out to Ravi at Avalanche. Expect reply tomorrow.

alisa (legal): NDA redlines sent to their counsel. Major note: add a 14-day review on any co-branded content. If they agree, I'll finalize.

sam (eng-lab): Two quick asks for infra team: (1) provide an SSH jump host + kube context for the vendor image, (2) a shared S3 bucket with lifecycle 90d for telemetry artifacts. Example mount command we'll use in harness: 

```bash
ssh -J jump@lab.company.com -i ~/.ssh/avalanche.pem ubuntu@10.10.5.12
sudo docker run --gpus all -v /mnt/models:/models redwood/bench:avalanche-v1 \
  --profile avalanche-eap-v1 --out /artifacts/avln_run.json
```

chris (hw-ops): Jump host + kube context will be ready by Mon. S3 bucket created: s3://avalanche-eap-1769876543 with perms to sam and chris.

henry (product): Good. Also list of success criteria for announcement: average p95 < 120ms for 512 tokens profile, no regressions on quality (eval set pass rate >= 95%). Share these in the weekly pulse.

marta (partnerships): Alisa — once NDA is accepted, I'll send an invite for the weekly sync and add marketing + product. Everyone else — can we confirm owners? Sam = bench runs, Chris = lab ops + SI contact, Alisa = NDA, Marta = partner lead, Henry = announcement gate.

sam (eng-lab): Owner ack. I'll post the bench run playbook to the repo after tests.

chris (hw-ops): Owner ack. Booking the SI deep-dive for Wed 2pm PT after our initial lab setup.

alisa (legal): Owner ack. Expecting countersign by Tue if their counsel responds.

marta (partnerships): Perfect. Last note: Avalanche asked if we can package a marketplace listing if the pilot is successful. We'll scope that in the post-pilot ops doc. :thumbsup:

hw-lab-bot: Reserved lab-seat for Avalanche EAP 1769876543 until 2026-04-28. Reminder set 3 days prior to handoff.

marta (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll publish the weekly calendar invite once NDA is in place. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

henry (product): +1, thanks.

sam (eng-lab): quick question — does Avalanche require us to run their microbench tool (avl-bench) or can we run our harness and share outputs?

chris (hw-ops): They prefer we run both: their microbench for silicon validation and our harness for end-to-end infra validation. Plan to run vendor microbench first, then our suite.

marta (partnerships): Noted. I'll add that to the kickoff checklist. End.
